blocks.text: IRMAA — What It Is and When It Applies

IRMAA (Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount) is a Medicare surcharge added to standard Part B and Part D premiums when household MAGI exceeds certain thresholds. It uses a two-year lookback — 2027 Medicare premiums are based on 2025 income. Both Brad and Lisa enroll in Medicare in 2027 (both turn 65 that year — Brad in June, Lisa in November).

blocks.text: RMDs — Required Minimum Distributions

RMDs begin at age 73 (2035 for both Brad and Lisa). The IRS requires minimum annual withdrawals from Traditional IRAs and 401ks. Roth IRAs have NO RMDs. HSAs have NO RMDs. The withdrawal amount equals account balance divided by an IRS life expectancy factor (26.5 at age 73).
